INSTAGRAM
I built a tool for competitive Pokémon players and 100+ signed up.

VGC Team Report turns a Showdown paste into a clean team report you can actually share.
The fun part: an overnight agent swarm picks up tickets from Linear and opens a draft pull request for me to review in the morning.
Small communities are a great place to start. You know the users because you are one.
Play VGC? Try it and tell me what feature you want next. Comments are my roadmap.
